author: HBO Max
description:
Michael Mando is here to defend Bane, and Batman fans might not like everything he has to say. On this episode of DC Studios Showcase: The Official Podcast, Frankey and Coy sit down with the actor behind Bane in Batman: Knightfall Part One: Knightfall for a no-holds-barred conversation about one of Batman’s most iconic Super-Villains. From why Bane believes Bruce Wayne is part of Gotham City’s problem to whether he’s “cheating” by using Venom, Michael makes the case that the DC Universe’s most compelling Super-Villains might have a point.

In this episode:

✅ Michael Mando explains why Bane doesn’t see himself as the bad guy, and why his arguments against Batman might actually hold up.
✅ Is Bane using Venom cheating? Michael makes the case for his superpower, and Batman’s gadgets get dragged into the debate.
✅ Why breaking Batman’s back is a moment of disappointment for Bane, not a victory lap.
